decisions.statement: A test asks about a call made at the root.
A call made anywhere else is the exception.
A test says so out loud.
The root a hook is judged against is bound before the hook is asked.
A test asking about a call under another root must name that root explicitly.
A hook's own judgement is handed in and handed back with its root bound.
The code here is set up by the tests that reach for this module.
Proving itself would prove nothing about any hook.

definition: a hook's judgement asked the way a test asks it, from the root it is in
